markdownRemark.html: After The Hobbit I knew that I was going to read the Lord of The Rings triology so I quickly got to The Fellowship Of The Ring and it did not disappoint at all. Truly I understand why people are so into this story and the world. The writing is good, the story is engaging, and although there is a lot of detail I didnt find it to be superfluous. I am definitely going to plow through them all.
